bullets.bullet_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital engagements, applying exotic pricing, liability Greeks, and higher-order stress testing to design robust hedge programs for regulated clients.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing initiatives, structuring traceable scenarios, challenger model variants, and model-risk remediation that produced audit-ready governance evidence for financial institutions.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics to strengthen risk-data aggregation.
